question_text: Describe the firm, its history, size and office locations.
answer_text: Example Firm LLP has advised public agencies since 1987. The firm has 38 attorneys and offices in Alder Bay, Stonemill and Greyhaven. We currently represent 60 public agencies as general or special counsel. Our general counsel group serves as city attorney or general counsel and advises on open meetings, public records, land use, contracts and personnel. The firm is owned by its partners and has no outside investors.

question_text: Describe your work plan and how you will keep the governing body informed.
answer_text: We propose to serve City of Fennimore Gap with one lead attorney who attends every regular City Council meeting and one backup attorney who knows the open files. Staff questions that do not need research are answered the same business day. Contracts and resolutions are reviewed within three business days unless staff asks for a faster turn. Before each meeting we review the agenda with the City Manager and flag open meeting, public records and conflict of interest questions. A monthly report lists open matters, hours and spending against the retainer. For a city we also attend Planning Commission meetings on request and advise on land use and code enforcement.

question_text: Identify the lead attorney and other proposed team members and their roles.
answer_text: We staff each engagement with a small team so that the City always speaks to someone who knows its matters. The lead attorney is responsible for all advice and attends meetings in person. The backup attorney is copied on open matters and can step in on short notice. Work is assigned to the attorney with the right experience at the lowest suitable rate. The attorneys proposed are listed below.

question_text: Describe relevant experience in the last five years.
answer_text: Example Firm LLP serves public agencies as city attorney or general counsel. The engagements listed below are the most similar to the work described in the request for proposals. In each one, attorneys proposed for City of Fennimore Gap did the work described. Our general counsel work includes meeting attendance, contract review, public records responses, land use advice and advice on conflicts of interest.

question_text: Provide references from public agency clients.
answer_text: The clients listed below have worked with the attorneys proposed for City of Fennimore Gap. We have confirmed that each contact is willing to be called.

question_text: Identify any client whose interests may conflict.
answer_text: We have checked our conflicts records for City of Fennimore Gap, its officials and the parties named in the request for proposals. We found no current or former client whose interests conflict with the City's. If a conflict arises during the engagement we will tell the City in writing at once.

question_text: State proposed fees, hourly rates and any retainer.
answer_text: We propose hourly rates with a not-to-exceed amount agreed in advance for each phase of the work. Invoices show the attorney, the task and the time for every entry. We do not bill for internal conferences between attorneys.

question_text: Describe local office and participation by small or local firms.
answer_text: Example Firm LLP has offices in Alder Bay, Stonemill and Greyhaven. The attorneys proposed for City of Fennimore Gap live and work in the region. The firm recruits from law schools in the region and reports the make-up of its attorneys and staff to its partners each year.

question_text: Describe how the firm would take over from current counsel.
answer_text: A transition has three steps: files, people and deadlines. We ask prior counsel for a status memo on each open matter and for the complete files. We introduce the team to staff and agree how requests will be sent and tracked. We confirm every litigation and contract deadline against the source documents. For continuity, the same lead attorney and backup attorney stay on the engagement for its full term.

question_text: Describe the firm, its history, size and office locations.
answer_text: Example Firm LLP is a public agency law firm with 38 attorneys. Our offices are in Alder Bay, Stonemill and Greyhaven. Our special district group serves as general counsel to water, fire, sanitary and recreation districts and advises on board governance, rates and charges, public works contracts and personnel. Every client has one responsible partner, and that partner stays on the engagement.

question_text: Describe your work plan and how you will keep the governing body informed.
answer_text: Day-to-day service to the District runs through the lead attorney. The lead attorney holds office hours at the District's offices twice a month and is available by telephone and email at other times. Urgent requests get a response within two hours during the business day. We keep a shared list of open requests so that staff can see who is handling each one and when it is due. Once a year we give the Board of Directors and staff training on open meeting and conflict of interest rules at no charge. For a district that sets its own rates we also review rate studies and notices for rates and charges, and we advise on water supply contracts and public works bidding as they arise.

question_text: Identify the lead attorney and other proposed team members and their roles.
answer_text: The team for Harlan Springs Fire Protection District is led by a partner who has served as city attorney or general counsel for other public agencies. A second partner is the designated backup and attends meetings when the lead attorney cannot. Associates handle research, contract review and public records responses under the lead attorney's supervision. We do not change the lead attorney without the District's consent. The attorneys proposed are listed below.

question_text: Describe relevant experience in the last five years.
answer_text: We have chosen engagements that match the District's needs in size and subject matter. Our special district work includes board governance, rates and charges, water supply contracts and public works bidding. We name a client only with the client's consent, so some engagements are described without the client's name.

answer_text: Our Greyhaven office is the closest to the District and will be the base for this engagement. question_text: Describe how the firm would take over from current counsel.

question_text: Describe the firm's approach to providing the services, including availability and response times.
answer_text: Our approach to negotiations has four parts: preparation, costing, communication and closing. In preparation we compare the District's agreements with those of similar employers. We agree ground rules on communicating with employees at the first session and we draft updates for the District to send. At closing we draft the tentative agreement language and check it against the table notes before signature.
